source: English Wiktionary, Azerbaijani entries, via the Kaikki.org machine-readable extract
method: The English etymology sentence of each Wiktionary etymology section is shown as written. The chain of source languages is read from that sentence (Borrowed from / Inherited from / From …); the origin label names the first non-Turkic language in the chain, or "Turkic origin" when every language named is Turkic, or "formed in Azerbaijani" for a word built from Azerbaijani parts. Homonyms are headwords with two or more etymology sections that each have meanings of their own; sections holding only inflected forms are ignored.
limitations: Wiktionary covers about 15,500 Azerbaijani entries; most headwords have no etymology here. Labels are derived from the sentence and inherit its accuracy. Not reviewed by an etymologist.
